project_summary: Card payments gateway for small online merchants

components.name: Card tokenization vault
components.description: PCI DSS compliant vault that replaces card numbers with tokens, using envelope encryption with a hardware security module and strict network segmentation.

components.name: Fraud detection rules engine
components.description: Configurable velocity and geolocation rules evaluated on every payment, with risk scores, manual review queue and merchant-level thresholds.

components.name: Merchant webhooks
components.description: Signed webhook delivery of payment events to merchants, with exponential backoff retries and a delivery log visible in the backoffice.

components.name: Merchant backoffice
components.description: Web backoffice for merchants to see payments, issue refunds, download settlement reports and manage API keys and team members.
